Via the search button, you can perform a targeted search for canine clinical trials. In order to do this, tick -if known- the box of your dog’s tumour type (‘Select tumour type’) and/or the countries (‘Select location’) for which you wish to know whether clinical trials are ongoing. Afterwards, a list of trials for which your dog might be eligible will appear. The listed information is limited to Treatment centre where the trial is available In/exclusion criteria.
